measurement_classes.native: Previously validated native lexical receipts, replayed without a new build; every selected source set is checked against its receipt.
measurement_classes.lexical_prototypes: Python full-history representation/selection experiments, not new native Rust retrieval measurements.
measurement_classes.reference: Previously cached Qwen embeddings, fact/query transformations and reranker probabilities; no new inference.
measurement_classes.reader: Prior official gpt-4o reader/judge dev artifacts only. No new QA score.
measurement_classes.oracle: Gold dependency-cost analysis is evaluation-only and never enters ranking.

paired_tokens.interpretation: Dev-sample uncertainty only; not held-out significance or LLM run variance.

lossless_context.production_latency: Rust compilation/tests via CI; native encoding latency not measured.
lossless_context.reader_effect: No new QA calls. Equal reconstructed sources establish encoding fidelity, not equal or improved reader accuracy.
lossless_context.cost_definition: o200k_base tokens for the complete context payload including digest, all source IDs, shared session identities and premise references. Full source receipt before; compact source payload after. Anchors/drops stay in the separate evidence receipt. Official QA history formatting differs; this is a context-format comparison, not an official-reader token saving.
lossless_context.count_completeness: Unknown. One packet retains the same raw rounds and sources; packet count is never reported as retrieval k.

enumeration_expansion.hypothesis: Use lossless metadata savings to append complete original-source closures for text-inferred enumeration queries without removing any baseline evidence.
enumeration_expansion.baseline: native selected: ten raw rounds, unchanged assistant weight 0.96
enumeration_expansion.intervention: Monotone append from admitted native candidates within role depth 128, capped at 64 original sources and 50 raw rounds; compact payload bytes <= the per-question baseline full source receipt bytes (or compact seed size if larger). Non-aggregation queries retain the seed only.
enumeration_expansion.decision: retain behind explicit API/CLI options; no default promotion before matched QA
enumeration_expansion.limitations: Variable raw-round budget. No hit@10 or complete-evidence@10 claim. Native candidate receipts are reused, not new model inference. Actual Rust acquisition with k=128/candidateLimit=1000 and latency remain unmeasured; candidate ranks at wider chunk depths may differ. Event identity, semantic sufficiency and exhaustive counts remain unverified.

bottlenecks.candidate_depth_definition: Native depth is per-role original rank among anchors admitted by the wide receipt (k=1000/role, 4096 sources, 2 MiB). Missing/dropped unscored anchors are not invented; deep curves are conservative admitted-pool measurements, not a claim of exhaustive history search. Reference depth counts uncompressed original user/assistant rounds, not sessions.

stage_limits.A: No annotated source absent from the admitted wide pool; unrelated unannotated omissions are not measured.
stage_limits.B: Representation adequacy cannot be separated causally from lexical mismatch using annotations alone.
stage_limits.F: Partial multi-source failures are flagged separately; annotations do not establish event identity or exhaustive counts.
stage_limits.G: Cached official-model reader/judge failures with all annotated turns are reader-or-judge failure candidates, not proof all semantically needed evidence reached the reader.
stage_limits.H: Six dev abstention questions excluded from positive retrieval metrics. No learned abstention accuracy claimed.

matrix.budget: Exact retained/retrieved tokens for this run not verified.
matrix.comparability: Requires pinned AMB configuration, prompts and model versions before matched comparison.

matrix.advertised: 99.2% session hit@8 and @10; 92.0% QA in current v3 README
matrix.metric: Binary any-evidence-session hit per question, not all-evidence recall
matrix.source_protocol: 500-question S; production search for SHR. QA harness separately enables session expansion and recall-surface routing from question text.
matrix.budget: Retrieved rows/turns with session-hit attribution, not ten complete evidence rounds; expanded QA context differs.
matrix.comparability: Retrieval-only hit is not answer accuracy or complete turn coverage. Raw-file cache served an older 89% category-routed report while current HTML/README described v3; revisions must be pinned.

matrix.metric: Session-level deterministic retrieval, three distinct aggregations
matrix.source_protocol: 500-question S; one entire haystack session per result; contextual nomic-embed-text 768d via Ollama, keyword/semantic weights 0.5/0.5.
matrix.budget: 20 entire sessions; raw rounds, source turns and reader tokens are not specified by the headline.
matrix.comparability: No QA score. Equal k does not match session and round context costs. The blog's claim that adding candidates can only help recall is not generally valid for fixed-k ranking.

matrix.metric: Harness rather than a competing score
matrix.comparability: Potential independent evaluation route; no score attributed to this framework.

fixed_round_ceiling.scope: All original sources in the fixed seed rounds, with no byte, token or source cap; annotations are inspected only after completion. This ceiling does not constrain selection of a different ten rounds.

same_round_completion.hypothesis: Lossless metadata savings can recover missing evidence by filling sources inside the existing ten raw rounds without increasing source-payload bytes or tokens over the full native source receipt.
same_round_completion.baseline: native selected, identical seed sources and raw-round membership
same_round_completion.intervention: Greedily append original sources from seed rounds, prioritizing referenced premises then smaller payloads; cap at 64 sources and each question's baseline full source-payload bytes and o200k_base tokens. Selection never sees annotations.
same_round_completion.decision: reject production promotion; retain this negative result

same_round_completion.limitations: A greedy Python receipt replay, not an exhaustive search or a native retrieval/QA measurement. A negative result does not prove that every equal-budget intervention must fail. No rank metrics are attributed to chronological source order.

tradeoff_assessment.serialization_redundancy: Lossless packing reduces source-payload tokens with identical original sources and category coverage; reader accuracy and latency remain unmeasured.

fixed_seed_round_ceiling.scope: All original sources in the fixed seed rounds, with no byte, token or source cap; annotations are inspected only after completion. This ceiling does not constrain selection of a different ten rounds.

tradeoff_assessment.interpretation: All-query expansion improves annotated evidence coverage at a larger raw-round budget while remaining cheaper than the full native source receipt in this serialization. Completing only existing rounds recovers no additional annotated evidence on frozen dev100; evaluation of all sources in those fixed rounds finds no missing annotation there even without context caps. This control has not eliminated the evidence/raw-round tradeoff; selecting a different ten rounds or other interventions may still do so. Neither result establishes a matched QA improvement.

development_selection: Frozen dev used for architecture selection/rejection. No fitted model or new role-weight sweep. Paired bootstrap intervals characterize dev examples, not held-out generalization. No claim of significance for a small number of recovered questions.

continuation.objective: Improve evidence sufficiency toward matched full-500 end-to-end SOTA; no comparable win established.
